photo.notes: No photos are shown. The visuals are drawn print art in one hand and one ink: the hero job-folder sketch (1440-first.jpg), the trailer with NET 1.87 t (1440-scroll-75.jpg), service pictograms ringed in red (1440-scroll-25.jpg) and the route map.
